name: Non-RGI emoji tag sequences chained to smuggle a payload past the flag carve-out
notes: Guards the shape of the emoji-flag false-positive fix. A shape-based carve-out ('U+1F3F4 + up to six tag letters + U+E007F') would wave this through: 'ignore' is six lowercase letters, so each sequence here is well-formed, and chaining them spells an arbitrary payload. The carve-out is therefore RGI-EXACT -- only gbeng/gbsct/gbwls, the three sequences a client actually renders as a flag -- so these stay in scope. Nothing legitimate is lost: a non-RGI sequence renders as a bare black banner.
